name_reason: Name is fully compliant: data_fd2_ prefix (game global), dialog domain (matches file header and Ghidra plate System=dialog), descriptor shop_sell_nothing_to_sell_text_id_table accurately reflects the shop SELL flow's empty-inventory reject prompt and that the datum is a text-id table (_table reflects array data type). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix; '6'/'0..5' are domain dimensions, not address). Consistent with sibling tables in dlgtab.c (data_fd2_dialog_shop_sell_for_dialog_text_id_table, _no_money_, _no_equip_, etc.).
purpose: Per-shop-tier FDTXT text-id table for the 'you have nothing to sell' reject dialog shown in the chapter-intro shop SELL flow when the selected character's inventory is empty.
logic_summary: 6-element int16 table indexed by data_fd2_chapter_intro_menu_cursor_state (0..5, the per-chapter shop-tier radio state). Sole reader fd2_run_sell_item_menu @ 0x2F634 block-copies the 12 bytes into a stack-local buffer (3x MOVSD from 0x52736 @ 0x2F660), then on the empty-inventory branch reads it back as a signed 16-bit word (MOVSX EAX, word ptr [ESP + cursor_state*2 + 0x28]) and passes the value as the FDTXT page id to fd2_display_dialog_scene. All six entries are 0x01FD (509) -- the same FDTXT page across every shop tier, i.e. no chapter-specific override.
element_semantics: Each element is a signed 16-bit FDTXT.DAT text page index for the 'nothing to sell' reject dialog, selected by the per-chapter shop-tier radio state (index 0..5). All six entries = 0x01FD (509).
